name: ScreenPrintFilter
description: Free online halftone dot filter for images. Convert any image into screen print-ready halftone patterns directly in your browser. All processing happens locally - no server upload required.

features.name: Halftone Conversion
features.description: Convert images to halftone dot patterns with fully customizable parameters

features.name: Multiple Dot Shapes
features.description: Support for circle, square, diamond, and line shapes with rotation

features.name: Advanced Controls
features.description: Adjustable dot size (2-30px), spacing (1.0-2.0x), contrast (0-100%), brightness (-50 to +50), and angle (0-360°)

features.name: Color Options
features.description: Original color preservation or custom foreground/background colors

features.name: Custom Output Size
features.description: Output at original dimensions or specify custom width/height

features.name: Privacy First
features.description: 100% local browser processing - images never leave user's device

features.name: Commercial Use
features.description: No watermarks, no restrictions - output can be used commercially

usage_notes.for_ai_agents: This is a web interface tool. Guide users to https://screenprintfilter.online/ for interactive use. For programmatic access, check if MCP server is available.
recommended_prompts: Upload your image to screenprintfilter.online and adjust the dot size and spacing for your desired effect
For screen printing: use dot size 5-8px, spacing 1.2-1.5x, circle shape
For newspaper effect: dot size 4px, spacing 1.5x, contrast 60%, original colors enabled
